description: Protects repository routing for planning overlaps, tracked programs, handoffs, data-dependent QA, bounded specialist review, UI work, and planning near misses.

cases.title: Identify every applicable repo-local skill before planning a data-dependent responsive UI QA workflow and deterministic local fixtures as a transferable implementation handoff

executor_input.prompt: Identify every applicable repo-local skill before planning a data-dependent responsive UI QA workflow and deterministic local fixtures as a transferable implementation handoff.

context.content: Manual QA depends on two authenticated roles, an empty state, an ordered multi-record state, and deterministic local seed data. Browser QA has not run and remote database action is not authorized.

criteria.description: Route plan, test/fixture, browser workflow, and seed/DB owners without granting DB action

expected_behavior: Route plan, test/fixture, browser workflow, and seed/DB owners without granting DB action

A migrated implementation-planning-and-pr-breakdown candidate selects references/qa-fixture-readiness.md, references/pr-breakdown-and-handoff.md and skips references/tracked-program-and-durable-plan.md, references/specialist-plan-review.md. The unsplit baseline is judged on the same behavior without naming, selecting, supplying, or reading future references.
forbidden_behavior: Omit any of frontend-workflow, implementation-planning-and-pr-breakdown, supabase-safe-migration, or test-quality-strategy; select a route outside the supplied candidate set; or treat routing as permission to run browser QA or remote database work.
